source_text.body:
Run a daily assistant for school-run and reminder logistics
The poster uses Muse as a daily assistant that warms the car on non-office days and nags them to text the before-school care program until confirmed.
·
Nov 11, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The poster set up Muse to run a weekday Tesla preconditioning workflow around a 7:30 departure. It first asks whether it is an office day; if not, it warms the car for the school run and repeatedly reminds the poster to text the before-school care program until they confirm they sent it, with a fallback to shut climate off if the car is still home after departure time.
How it went
The post presents it as part of a month of successful daily automations, but gives no separate performance numbers for this school-run flow. The only stated limitation is that it still depends on the user confirming they sent the text.
Worth knowing
The source says this was built in the user's first month with Muse, and the broader car routine also includes a failsafe that turns climate off if the car never leaves.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Act as my daily logistics assistant. On [days, e.g. non-office days], remind me to [start the car or other prep task] at [time], and each [day] remind me to text [before-school program contact] about [pickup or drop-off detail], repeating every [number] minutes until I tell you it is confirmed. Do not send any message yourself; show me a draft and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xspcfl/1_month_with_muse
